Appreciate the specifics — below is a concise unit-econ view using the volumes and constraints you shared. I kept the math high-level; full workbook attached.

Assumptions (examples pulled from the attached model)
- Model/inference baseline cost (our internal cost to serve, weighted across candidates): $120 / 1M tokens at no commitment (price varies by model family).
- Committed discount tiers: 50M–100M tokens -> $90 / 1M; 100M–300M -> $65 / 1M; 300M+ -> $45 / 1M (these are illustrative, final pricing in contract).
- Redwood platform markup for hosted inference + SLA/observability: applied after commitment tier; typical list prices in model: $200 / 1M (no commit), $150 / 1M (50–100M commit), $110 / 1M (100–300M commit).

Example target $/1M tokens for FinTechX (recommended): $110 / 1M with a 100M token committed baseline. This keeps your blended unit cost competitive while letting us guarantee latency/priority.

$ / feature (example math)
- Chat assistant (avg 3,000 tokens per active session)
  - Tokens per session: 3,000 -> sessions per 1M tokens = ~333
  - Cost @ $110 / 1M = $110 / 333 = $0.33 per session
  - If MAU = 10k users with 3 sessions/mo -> monthly cost = 10k * 3 * $0.33 = $9,900
- Document summarization (avg 500 tokens per summary)
  - Tokens per summary: 500 -> 2,000 summaries per 1M tokens
  - Cost per summary = $110 / 2000 = $0.055 (5.5 cents)
  - If 5k summaries/mo -> monthly cost = 5k * $0.055 = $275
- Semantic search + rerank (avg 2,000 tokens per query x 5 candidates = 10,000 tokens per query)
  - Tokens per query: 10,000 -> 100 queries per 1M tokens
  - Cost per query = $110 / 100 = $1.10
  - If 20k queries/mo -> monthly cost = 20k * $1.10 = $22,000

Unit economics & margin targets
- Example revenue per customer (target segment): $2,500 MRR (avg)
- Incremental inference cost per customer (with chat + summarization use case in pilot): ~$12 / month -> inference contribution margin is very high relative to ARR.
- If CAC = $6,000, and NRR + expansion expected, payback months = CAC / (gross contribution margin * monthly revenue). Using a 60% gross margin target, payback = $6,000 / (0.6 * $2,500) ≈ 4 months — within your <6 month target.

Notes and sensitivity
- Reranking-heavy workloads drive token usage non-linearly; batching and prefix caching can cut effective token consumption for repeated requests by ~20–40% depending on access patterns (we model this in tab "cache_effects").
- For aggressive margin targets we recommend: commit to 100M tokens, enable prefix caching for chat flows, and use a mid-sized model family for reranking (reduces per-1M cost).

Recommended next steps
1) Agree pilot commitment: 60-day pilot with 100M baseline (we'll provide trial credits toward first 20M).
2) Pricing call to lock the commitment tier and overage mechanics — propose Wed 9:00 AM PT.
3) Legal & procurement: Ana and our Legal ops will trade a standard SOW and SOC2 artifacts.

I attached the workbook with the sensitivity scenarios and the PDF pricing options. Let me know if you'd like a version with your exact MAU/usage assumptions plugged in (we can do that live on the call).
